caption: The drawing features two objects centered against a plain, off-white background. The larger object at the bottom is a powder horn, mostly a light tan color with darker brown hues from the horn material, and it has inscriptions or engraved markings all along its curved surface. The powder horn has a metallic-looking spout that is dark gray and tapers to a narrow opening. At the end opposite the spout, there is a flat, capped end with a small metal loop attached. Above and slightly to the right, there is a smaller pipe-like object, possibly also a horn or pipe, featuring a light cream color with a reddish-brown wooden or cork end. It is curved and also bears faint engravings or markings, and the tip is capped with a slightly raised section. The objects are presented in a side-by-side fashion, not touching, with the larger horn positioned diagonally and the smaller object above it horizontally. Both items display detailed renderings of their textures and engravings.
title: Powder Horn
